title: Ye De Ming Ming Shu
synopsis: After a difficult upbringing, Qingchen's life takes a drastic turn when a mysterious countdown emerges on his arm. He is taken to Prison No. 18, a dangerous parallel universe, when it reaches zero. He overcomes severe adversity and gains the respect of the demigod Li Shutong by using his cunning and bravery. He then becomes his disciple and embarks on a journey of genuine transformation.

Can Skye survive and finally seize her own happiness? A relatable story exploring trust, friendship, love and the ever uncertainty of the future. (Source: Tapas)

title: Deng Xia Jiu Fa
synonyms: Apotheosis in Nine Acts: How I End Up Saving the World
synopsis: Chu Sheng, a street punk, accidentally stumbles into the world of cultivation. Hoping to latch onto an immortal sect to easily counterattack and win at life, he discovers instead that the "Nine Laws of Ascension" is a psychotic evil art that uses living people as nourishment. The future world has long since been refined into a land crawling with evil spirits, and even Chu Sheng himself, a Heavenly Dao Walker with the ability to "merge all things", is nothing more than a spare ration for the immortals. Gathering a group of absurd teammates, he travels to the future to purge the evil spirits, using his Heavenly Dao abilities to clash head-on with evil arts in blood-and-flesh combat filled with nonsensical humor. The path to ascension offers only one chance of survival in ten thousand. Want to become an immortal? Survive tonight first. (Source: BiliBili, translated)

synopsis: The storm rises once more on Rakshasa Street as all factions stir into motion. The combined forces of Cao, Sun, and Liu are unstoppable, leaving the Hall of Heroes gravely damaged. Amid the chaos, heroes rise one after another, while the Kingdom Organization's ambitions brew a new crisis. (Source: Bilibili TV)

title: Tiandao Tushuguan
synopsis: Traversing into another world, Zhang Xuan finds himself becoming an honorable teacher. Along with his transcension, a mysterious library appears in his mind. As long as it is something he has seen, regardless of whether it is a human or an object, a book on its weaknesses will be automatically compiled in the library. Thus, he becomes formidable.

title: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji
titleRomaji: Wo Zai Feitu Shijie Sao Laji
synopsis: Zhu Ning, a warrior who slayed in all directions in a zombie apocalypse, unexpectedly dies and is transported to a wasteland filled with unknowns and fantasy. She becomes a fifth-class citizen, the lowest rank in the world, forced to make a living by "scavenging garbage." However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world. (Source: Bilibili, translated)
